svg.title: Meowthos · one small workbench
svg.desc: An original pixel workbench with a monitor, a glass of water, a paper nameplate and a small black cat. The cat occasionally reaches toward a loose keycap and tucks its paw back. Inside the monitor is a genuine ten-second Cube Snake recording at thirty legal moves per second, followed by a visible replay interlude. This picture is not an interactive game; the surrounding link opens the playable Cube Snake page. Light, dark and static companions are provided.
